beats.say: Stack one penny. Double the stack ninety nine times, and it's taller than the universe is wide.
One penny is one point five two millimeters thick. Ten doublings: over one and a half meters of pennies.
Doubling twenty three: almost thirteen kilometers. You just passed Mount Everest.
Doubling thirty: sixteen hundred kilometers, way above the space station.
And that stack of pennies is worth over ten million dollars.
Doubling thirty eight: past the Moon.
Doubling forty seven: past the Sun.
Eighty four: past the nearest star, out of our galaxy, and past Andromeda.
Doubling ninety nine: about a hundred and two billion light years. The observable universe is ninety three.
Too bad you can't try it. The US Mint made its last pennies for circulation in November 2025.
beats.speak: Too bad you can't try it. The U S Mint made its last pennies for circulation in November, twenty twenty five.

title: One penny doubled 99 times is taller than the universe is wide
caption: A US penny is 1.52 mm thick. Double the stack every step. 10 doublings: 1.56 m. 23 doublings: 12.75 km, taller than Everest (8,848.86 m). 30 doublings: 1,632 km of pennies, way above the space station (about 250 miles up), and 1,073,741,824 pennies is $10,737,418.24. 38 doublings: 417,814 km, past the Moon (384,400 km). 47: past the Sun. 65: past Proxima Centauri (4.22 light-years). 84: past Andromeda (2.5 million light-years). 99 doublings: about 102 billion light-years, more than the width of the observable universe (about 93 billion light-years). You can't actually try it: the US Mint struck its last pennies for circulation in November 2025. That's exponential growth: 2 to the power of 99.
facts: start 0.00152 m, factor 2. step=ceil(log2(landmark/start)): Everest 23 (12,750.68 m), ISS 28 (408,022 m), Moon 38 (417,814,419 m), Sun 47 (2.139e11 m), Proxima 65 (5.61e16 m), Andromeda 84 (2.94e22 m), universe 99 (9.634e26 m = 101.84 billion ly at 9.46e15 m/ly). Step 10: 1.556 m. Step 30: 1,632,087.6 m, 2^30 pennies = $10,737,418.24. Coin World: final circulating cent struck Nov 12 2025; ABC: Nov 11 2025, so only 'November 2025' is stated.
